standard: shampoo-classification-v1.6.1 candidate (lane-a scrubbed copy); not a locked policy id

formulaBlock.normalization: ID-2: no synonym or split entries; 36 normalized entries; normalized positions

cleansingStrength.rationale: moderate by C5: defining anionic Sodium Coco-Sulfate @2 (alkyl sulfate type) with at least two prominent buffers (Cocamidopropyl Betaine @3, Disodium Lauryl Sulfosuccinate @4, Sodium Methyl Oleoyl Taurate @5, Heptyl Glucoside @14, Disodium Cocoamphodiacetate @17) and no reinforcing strong anionic. Sulfated Castor Oil @16 is not a cleansing route (C3b). Counter-signal: alkyl sulfate chassis; four or more buffers make the C5 value robust.

conditioningLevel.rationale: high by C2 with the payload-lipid substitution: no silicone, but a prominent payload lipid takes its place (Hydrogenated Castor Oil @23, plus the emollient ester Lauryl/Myristyl Polyricinoleate @12), cationic polymer Hydroxypropyl Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride @10, pearlizing route Glycol Distearate @7, deliberate humectants Glycerin @29 and Sorbitol @31 (both before Parfum @32); plus cationic conditioner Behenoyl PG-Trimonium Chloride @11. Counter-signal: no silicone; the lipid and humectant elements sit late (after Piroctone Olamine @19); neighbor moderate.

material: Lauryl/Myristyl Polyricinoleate @12 (emollient ester; read as payload_lipid, P0)
nonMaterial: Hydrogenated Castor Oil @23 (waxy; after the W-line)
Stearic Acid @24, Palmitic Acid @25 (fatty acids; after the W-line)

reset: strong anionic alkyl sulfate Sodium Coco-Sulfate @2
mild anionic Disodium Lauryl Sulfosuccinate @4, Sodium Methyl Oleoyl Taurate @5
excluded: Sulfated Castor Oil @16 (no weight family, 6.4 v1.6.1)
Cetyl Hydroxyethylcellulose @26 (nonionic cellulose thickener, no cationic charge)
Zinc Oxide @28 (mineral particle, not a deposition family)

wLineRecord.note: No a-c candidate before @19 (no fragrance allergen, preservative or sub-1 % active earlier). Piroctone Olamine @19: (i) surfactants before; (ii) between @20 and @31 no cleansing surfactant (Capryloyl Glycine @21 is in no C3 class), no alkanolamide, no pearlizing wax. Salicylic Acid @20 is never a candidate.

weightPotential.counterevidence: W-RICH is formally established for weight (material emollient ester @12 converging with cationic guar @10 and a behenyl quat @11), and a waxy Hydrogenated Castor Oil @23 plus fatty acids @24-25 are present after the W-line.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Plausible, bounded residue from a cationic guar, a behenoyl quat and an emollient ester; the C5 coco-sulfate chassis with four buffers is an effective ordinary reset (resetCapacity moderate), so W-RICH does not reach the high anchor's rich route (limited reset = weak).
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: high: W-RICH is present but reset is not limited; the convergence route (cationic polymer + cationic conditioner + one material ester) is not strong enough to overcome an effective alkyl-sulfate chassis, and the waxy Hydrogenated Castor Oil @23 is after the W-line, so it cannot add a lipid leg. low: two cationic families plus an emollient ester are a plausible depositing system (W2).
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: W-LINE item 6: the post-line Hydrogenated Castor Oil @23 is part of what keeps the band from high (confidence at most moderate, neighbor high); W-RICH recorded as counter-signal.
weightPotential.rationale: moderate: W-RICH with moderate reset falls to the rest of the method (6.7 W-RICH limited reset); confidence moderate, neighbor high.

careDirection.limitation: formula-only; scalp-type actives dominate the formula character

focusPrimary.counterSignal: Piroctone Olamine @19, Salicylic Acid @20, Salix Alba Bark Extract @8, Mentha Piperita Oil @9 point to a scalp/dandruff role, which needs positioning.
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Blind pass: claim direction null; provisional general.

focusSecondary.decisionTrace: Empty default considered; no claims visible.

usageRole.rationale: provisional regular; treatment if a qualifying dandruff claim appears (U3); frequent possible with U2 wording (cleansing moderate).

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: provisional not_targeted (no positioning visible). CSA formula half met by prominent humectant/refatting routes Glycerin @29, Sorbitol @31 and the hydrogenated lipid Hydrogenated Castor Oil @23; no prominent E4 comfort route (an S-SENSITIVE gate would fail). Counter-signals: prominent cooling essential oil Mentha Piperita Oil @9 and Salicylic Acid @20; with a listed route present they cap targeted at moderate.

dandruffSupport.rationale: supported: Piroctone Olamine @19 in a complete formula (Section 11). Salicylic Acid and Zinc Oxide do not count.

nonionicCleansing: Heptyl Glucoside @14 (assigned by its glucoside name; short-chain, see uncertainties)
surfactantClasses.c4: defining Sodium Coco-Sulfate @2; buffers @3, @4, @5, @14, @17; no reinforcing route

scalpExposure: Mentha Piperita Oil @9 (prominent cooling essential oil)

uncertainties: Lauryl/Myristyl Polyricinoleate @12: read as payload_lipid (emollient ester, 6.3) under P0; alternative weak_refatter. With the alternative there is no material payload_lipid and no W-RICH; the band stays moderate but its counter-signal weakens.

Heptyl Glucoside @14 assigned nonionic cleansing by its glucoside name (C3 name rule); it is a short-chain hydrotrope in practice. It changes nothing: C5 already has three or more other buffers and it lies before the W-line candidate.
conditioningLevel high rests on C2 lipid substitution with the lipid and humectant elements in the late prominent zone; alternative moderate.
